newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt to give telephone authority corporate status.
newsitem.headline: Egypt to give telephone authority corporate status.

text.p: The Egyptian government is preparing to give the state telecommunications authority corporate status, official sources said on Wednesday.
The step is the natural prelude towards eventual privatisation of telecommunications but the sources said the government was not yet ready to show its hand.
Telecommunications in Egypt have been strictly a state monopoly, currently held by the highly profitable National Telecommunications Authority ARENTO.
But ARENTO showed the first chink in its armour last month when it invited pre-qualification applications from companies interested in installing and operating payphones.

The authoritative magazine MEED said Global One, a joint venture between France Telecom, Deutsche Telekom and Sprint of the United States, was teaming up with National Bank of Egypt to provide phone services, starting with payphones and phone cards.
